sentences.text: As per the prosecution story, on 17th of September, 2023 father of hte prosecutrix has lodged a missing person report at Police Station Kudila, stating that on 13th of September, 2023 he left his home in the morning wherein the prosecutrix was in home and when he returned in the evening to his home, he could not find prosecutrix.

sentences.text: The father of the prosecutrix further stated that he asked his daughter-in-law for prosecutrix to which she has replied that prosecutrix at around 4 p.m. went for the nature's call after which she did not return.

sentences.text: After recovery of almost two years on the basis of statement of the prosecutrix, the aforesaid registered the aforesaid offence against the applicant.

sentences.text: Heard on I.A.No.14346/2025, which is second application under Section 430 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (equivalent to Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C.) for suspension of remaining jail sentence and grant of bail on behalf of the appellant - Vinod S/o Basantilal .

sentences.text:
His first application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 01/08/2024 passed on IA.No.16421/2023.
2.
sentences._hearing_file: Vinod vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: The appellant stands convicted under Sections 450, 342 and 376(D) of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and sentenced to undergo 10 years' RI with fine of Rs.100/-; 01 year's RI with fine of Rs.100/-; and 20 years' RI with fine of Rs.100/- respectively with usual default stipulation.
sentences._hearing_file: Vinod vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: 3. Prosecution case in brief is that prosecutrix lodged an FIR on 28/06/2019 stating that she resides at Nagda along with her husband and minor daughter.
sentences._hearing_file: Vinod vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: On dated 27/06/2019 at around 05:00 PM when she was taking out clothes from a bag, appellant / brother-in-law Vinod and Shankar came inside the house.
sentences._hearing_file: Vinod vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: When prosecutrix questioned them, co-accused Shankar tried to commit sexual offence with her.
sentences._hearing_file: Vinod vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: When she tried to run out of the house, appellant closed the main door of house and thereafter, co- accused Shankar caught hold the prosecutrix, pushed her on the floor and 2 CRA-5174-2023 committed rape upon her.
sentences._hearing_file: Vinod vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: Thereafter, appellant also came inside the house and committed rape.
sentences._hearing_file: Vinod vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that as per the testimony of the prosecutrix, she had not identified the appellant.
sentences._hearing_file: Vinod vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: He argued that the statement of prosecutrix is not trustworthy as she had not been consistent in her testimony before the Court.
sentences._hearing_file: Vinod vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: The DNA report of co-convict Shankar only has been found positive.
sentences._hearing_file: Vinod vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: The appellant has already remained in jail for 04 years, 11 months and 02 days, meaning thereby, he has suffered incarceration period of almost 05 years.
sentences._hearing_file: Vinod vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: This is an appeal of the year 2023 and final hearing of the appeal may take long time.
sentences._hearing_file: Vinod vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: Hence, under such circumstances prayer is made for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail to this appellant.
sentences._hearing_file: Vinod vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent / State has opposed the prayer for suspension of jail sentence and submitted that prosecution has successfully proved the case and the application is liable to be dismissed.
sentences._hearing_file: Vinod vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: 6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the entirety of the facts; testimony of the prosecutrix; the fact that only the DNA of co-convict has matched; appellant has remained in jail for almost 05 years; and final hearing of the appeal is likely to take considerable time, hence, without expressing any conclusive opinion on merits, we find it to be a fit case to suspend the remaining custodial sentence of the appellant.
sentences._hearing_file: Vinod vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: 7. Accordingly, I.A.No.14346/2025 is allowed and it is directed that the execution of remaining jail sentence against the appellant shall remain 3 CRA-5174-2023 suspended till the final disposal of the appeal and he be released on bail upon his depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, and upon furnishing bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 13/07/2026 and on all subsequent dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Registry.
sentences._hearing_file: Vinod vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: 8. With the aforesaid, I.A stands allowed and disposed off.
sentences._hearing_file: Vinod vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: 9. I.A.No.14345/2025, which is an application for urgent hearing of application for suspension of sentence, also stands disposed of.

opennyai_summary.final__facts:
His first application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 01/08/2024 passed on IA.No.16421/2023.
2.
On dated 27/06/2019 at around 05:00 PM when she was taking out clothes from a bag, appellant / brother-in-law Vinod and Shankar came inside the house.
When prosecutrix questioned them, co-accused Shankar tried to commit sexual offence with her.
When she tried to run out of the house, appellant closed the main door of house and thereafter, co- accused Shankar caught hold the prosecutrix, pushed her on the floor and 2 CRA-5174-2023 committed rape upon her.
Thereafter, appellant also came inside the house and committed rape.
opennyai_summary.final__arguments:
4. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that as per the testimony of the prosecutrix, she had not identified the appellant.
Hence, under such circumstances prayer is made for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail to this appellant.
opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS: 6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the entirety of the facts; testimony of the prosecutrix; the fact that only the DNA of co-convict has matched; appellant has remained in jail for almost 05 years; and final hearing of the appeal is likely to take considerable time, hence, without expressing any conclusive opinion on merits, we find it to be a fit case to suspend the remaining custodial sentence of the appellant.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
7. Accordingly, I.A.No.14346/2025 is allowed and it is directed that the execution of remaining jail sentence against the appellant shall remain 3 CRA-5174-2023 suspended till the final disposal of the appeal and he be released on bail upon his depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, and upon furnishing bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 13/07/2026 and on all subsequent dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Registry.
8. With the aforesaid, I.A stands allowed and disposed off.
9. I.A.No.14345/2025, which is an application for urgent hearing of application for suspension of sentence, also stands disposed of.
